snippet.title: Terrible Lizards - Official Overview Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running. Get deep dive into Terrible Lizards in this latest trailer for the upcoming game. Terrible Lizards will be available on PC in summer 2026.
